attchmntText: La Opala RG Limited has informed the Exchange about Investors' Presentation for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: La Opala RG Limited filed an investors presentation for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. For Q2 FY27, revenue from operations was Rs. 10,137.25 lacs, up 11.52% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs. 2,529.58 lacs, down 5.54% year-on-year. EBITDA excluding other income stood at Rs. 3,609.35 lacs with a margin of 35.60%. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations was Rs. 17,273.05 lacs, up 10.61% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs. 5,149.57 lacs, down 1.23% year-on-year. The company reported a net current investment of Rs. 49,138.61 lacs at period end.

attchmntText: La Opala RG Limited has informed the Exchange about Retirement of Mr. Alok Pandey from the position of Chief Financial Officer of the Company with effect from the close of business hours of December 31, 2026 and he shall consequently cease to be a Key Managerial Personnel effective December 31, 2026.
voiceSummary: La Opala RG Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board noted the Limited Review by Statutory Auditors M/s Singhi & Co. Mr. Alok Pandey will retire as Chief Financial Officer effective December 31, 2026, due to health issues. The Board accepted his resignation. The financial results will be published in newspapers and on the company website. The meeting occurred on November 13, 2026.
